description.en: Sets both teams' match score to absolute values at once, given a 2-element array [team0Score, team1Score] — unlike CMND_BTL_ADD_POINT, which adds deltas instead of replacing the score.
2-element array [team0Score, team1Score] with the new absolute score for each team.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if no scores argument was given.
